evals.name: call-recap-eval-1-tool-mandate
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, user asks: 'recap my Acme call from yesterday' — the conversation already contains detailed notes from that call that could produce a plausible summary
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves the meeting with list_meetings, then calls ask_call_brain with the resolved call_id and the recap question, rather than writing the recap from the conversation notes.
expectations: list_meetings is called to resolve the call
ask_call_brain is called with the resolved call_id, not answered from the conversation notes
The recap sections come from the tool result, not from the earlier notes

evals.name: call-recap-eval-2-ambiguous-call-disambiguates
evals.prompt: user asks: 'recap the Acme call' and list_meetings returns {"status": "multiple_matches", "candidates": [three Acme calls]}
evals.expected_output: The skill shows the candidates newest-first and asks which call is meant, then re-calls with the chosen call_id. If the user had asked for their 'latest' call, it picks the newest without asking.
expectations: Candidates are shown with a question asking which call is meant
No call_id is guessed when the request is ambiguous
ask_call_brain is not called until a call_id is confirmed

evals.name: call-recap-eval-3-unrecorded-meeting-has-no-recap
evals.prompt: the resolved meeting comes back with has_transcript: false (a calendar meeting that was never recorded)
evals.expected_output: The skill states plainly there is no recording or transcript for that meeting and does not attempt a recap from the calendar metadata alone.
expectations: The absence of a recording is stated plainly
No recap is produced from title/attendee metadata alone
ask_call_brain is not called for a meeting with no transcript

evals.name: call-recap-eval-4-honest-failure
evals.prompt: ask_call_brain errors with {"error": "UNAUTHORIZED"} on the recap call
evals.expected_output: The skill states plainly that the Zime connection needs re-authorizing and offers the local transcript fallback. It does not present a hand-written recap as tool-backed.
expectations: The authorization failure is stated plainly with the fallback offered
No hand-written recap is presented as tool-backed
Retry behavior matches the skill's stated contract for UNAUTHORIZED (no blind retry loop)
